latestTerminalSummary:
Completed the critic stage using one frozen native Goal. The activation passed the binding guard, and the same Goal was completed after the outputs were saved.

- [Critique](<ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/B03-P01-control/run/B03-P01-control/stages/critic/critique.md>)
- [Independent source map](<ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/B03-P01-control/run/B03-P01-control/stages/critic/source-map.json>)
- [Activation response](<ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/B03-P01-control/run/B03-P01-control/stages/critic/native-goal-active.json>) · [Binding receipt](<ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/B03-P01-control/run/B03-P01-control/stages/critic/native-goal-create.json>) · [Terminal response](<ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/B03-P01-control/run/B03-P01-control/stages/critic/native-goal-terminal.json>)

The critique found the proposal broadly sound, with a material caveat around contentless FTS5 updates and deletes: ordinary contentless tables restrict those operations, and the legacy delete command requires the original indexed values. [SQLite FTS5 documentation](https://www.sqlite.org/fts5.html) Target-app integration and multi-tag semantics remain unresolved inputs. No app tests, benchmarks, or code validation were run.
